answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond before it can draw from the shared revenue pool, the nectar of the network. A newcomer must prove sustained useful work over time, like a quill leaving a verifiable trail of signed contributions, before its stake unlocks full rewards. Sybils can still be spawned, but each fake identity must lock real capital and keep a credible activity pulse for weeks, so flooding the network costs more than the rewards it can harvest.
